mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, conditions are clear at the Verona Public Library, and we are currently under a waning crescent moon.
The city has shared updated information on residential detached garages and shed permitting, alongside new procedures for the autumn leaf collection using a new vacuum truck.
Enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus Brewing and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus several more events throughout the week.
On October 3, local officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man who was in possession of a stolen firearm during a traffic stop.
Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM tonight.
